title: Distinguish malformed nested repository metadata from a metadata escape in review identity refusals
outcome: A malformed nested .git file or non-repository .git directory produces embedded_repository_invalid; a pointer outside admitted storage retains git_metadata_escape.
acceptance: A nested .git file lacking a valid gitdir pointer and a nested .git directory that is not a Git repository refuse as embedded_repository_invalid, without admitting additional storage or following unsupported links.

Focused regressions distinguish both malformed embedded-repository shapes from a pointer resolving outside admitted storage, which still refuses as git_metadata_escape; the fix follows the required review and exact-input gate policy.
